title: Scheduling Coordinator Reference: Move Lead and the Deposit on a Moved In-Person Appointments Visit
content:
The deposit a moved In-Person Appointments visit requires takes an addition according to the days the latest move left between the day of the move and the new scheduled date:

| Days between the day of the latest move and the new scheduled date | Added to the deposit the moved visit requires |
|---|---|
| fewer than 14 | 50.00 dollars |
| 14 to 44 | 25.00 dollars |
| 45 or more | nothing |

For a visit never moved, the days are counted from its booking date to its scheduled date. The latest move is the date of the latest reschedule on the appointment record, and the visit counts as moved when the record shows a reschedule count of one or more patient-requested reschedules.

**Edges (hypothetical moves to a new scheduled date of 2026-12-20).**

- Moved on 2026-12-07: 13 days, 50.00 dollars. Moved on 2026-12-06: 14 days, 25.00 dollars.
- Moved on 2026-11-06: 44 days, 25.00 dollars. Moved on 2026-11-05: 45 days, nothing.
- Never moved, booked on 2026-12-01 for 2026-12-20: 19 days from the booking date, 25.00 dollars.
